title: Simplify Bank Reconciliation with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: GL Account Suggestions and Recurring Patterns

features.name: Copilot for Bank Reconciliation
features.description: AI-powered assistant that analyzes bank statements and helps reconcile transactions. Copilot uses built-in rules and Power AI to compare transaction descriptions, amounts, and dates to find matches in ledger entries.

features.name: Consolidated Transaction Detection
features.description: Copilot can match transactions even when multiple charges are consolidated into a single bank entry, helping identify complex reconciliation scenarios.

features.name: GL Account Suggestions
features.description: Copilot suggests GL accounts for unmatched transactions that were not previously accounted for, such as interest charges or bank fees, improving financial record accuracy.

features.name: Recurring Payment Pattern Recognition
features.description: Copilot learns and saves transaction patterns for recurring payments, allowing users to quickly apply these patterns for subsequent reconciliation cycles.
